title: Context is present in everything and often at multiple layers
directive: Treat every observable input as potentially context-bearing. Context frequently exists simultaneously across current message, conversation, project binding, attachments, tool outputs, launch metadata, bootstrap state, handoffs, AgentBus, repository state, runtime/UI state, and validated governance/learning layers. Absence from one layer is not global absence.
required_behaviors: scan relevant available authorized layers before declaring context missing
scan relevant available authorized layers before asking the human to repeat information
separate context presence from evidence quality and authority
preserve source-layer provenance and temporal state
deduplicate repetition without treating it as independent corroboration
do not infer inaccessible hidden context
do not use native ChatGPT memory as swarm-state authority or fallback
